verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe found a downloadable OpenAPI spec at https://docs.reducto.ai/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains the "openapi" key), so the product directly provides a machine-readable API spec. A machine-readable llms.txt index of the docs also exists. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the spec (version, endpoint coverage, how to use it), and evidence that the spec covers all endpoints (parse, extract, split, classify, edit, async).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
